newStaticFindings.finding: Calls IGetAttributeSettingSetupAction to obtain data_model_definition, prop_ids, setting_info and attr_data_types. Attribute presentation picks item_meaning_id+attr, refer_type+attr, refer_group+attr, stripped data_type+attr, then plain attr_id; an existing owner attribute value wins over returned default_value. These are settings-editor conversion rules, not established upload numeric/required policy.
template/template_code/calc/default choose different conversion features. Actual upload policy cannot be inferred from template conversion.
menu_type upload takes a distinct web-upload branch before valid_key_list is read. The non-upload branch depends on valid_key_list and sub_array_list.

Uses upload definition refer types to identify record_sid, upload_result and upload_status. A cloned row excludes record_sid/upload_result; truthy upload_status excludes the row, otherwise remaining nonempty values determine check_valid_row at the original index. Reduce builds an accumulator but this function does not assign it back to data_model. Exact vIsEmpty semantics and status value meaning are outside these scopes.

For upload, resolves upload model/definition; if absent it returns. If check_valid_row exists and no true entry remains, reports not_null against the first display-ordered property. This is an aggregate nonempty-row check, not an AND-required rule for every bold column.

input_required_value menu attribute controls whether line-required validation runs. Upload uses the without-key-props branch; eligible internal import-target prop IDs, exclusions including upload_seq, typed-code emptiness, detail definition and data determine presence. It does not use the non-upload valid_key_list branch.

historicalInterpretationCorrection.correction: Those methods describe non-upload branches. Earlier validatorScope language must not be read as proof that upload uses valid_key_list. No deployed upload-saving/conditional-required implementation was based on that inference; saving remains disabled.
